deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this CRPS-blackbox case must Over voltage on output (forcing an over-voltage condition on the PSU output) so the PSU blackbox records it, using fault-injection hardware/throttle/AC on the physical PSU, and then reads the blackbox/fault log - a physical, destructive fault injection a person must perform. Agent cannot inject PSU input/output faults or read the physical blackbox.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator Over voltage on output (forcing an over-voltage condition on the PSU output) and then extracts the PSU blackbox fault record; agent cannot inject the fault or access the physical blackbox (only the BMC SEL after the fact, which the operator captures).
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: physical PSU insertion/pull/AC operation at the machine - human only; agent must not attempt.

original_test_intent: Verify that a controlled output over-voltage event is recorded in the target CRPS PSU blackbox with the expected fault status and event correlation.
original_method: On an isolated test system, a qualified operator applies the vendor-approved over-voltage profile to a named output rail with independent measurement and cutoff. The approved blackbox interface then exports the raw record for code/field/timestamp comparison and recovery confirmation.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer must configure and control the over-voltage source, independent instrumentation and cutoff. Blackbox extraction/correlation may be automated after the vendor interface and record contract are available.
required_inputs: PSU/DUT identity and exact target output rail
Vendor-approved voltage waveform, threshold, tolerance, duration and expected protection response
Isolated fixture, load state, calibrated independent measurement and emergency cutoff
Blackbox extraction tool/schema and expected over-voltage record fields
Operator, recovery/inspection plan and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Do not generate over-voltage through an unknown fixture, register write, protection bypass, AC manipulation or guessed method.
Use isolation, independent voltage/current capture, hard cutoff and vendor absolute limits.
Protect attached loads and preserve baseline logs; do not clear evidence.
Stop for profile exceedance, failed protection, heat, smoke, arcing, damage, shutdown or management loss.
No automatic reinjection, retry, reset or power cycle.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare synchronized evidence capture and verify approved plan inputs.
Collect permitted pre-event status and post-operator blackbox/BMC/host artifacts.
Correlate measured voltage/time, protection behavior and raw blackbox fields.
Report observations without applying voltage or declaring the verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve/operate the over-voltage fixture and safety envelope.
Execute emergency cutoff and recovery/inspection as needed.
Provide inaccessible blackbox artifacts and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly refuses agent execution but is not a method; its physical/AC alternatives are speculative and cannot substitute for a vendor-defined rail voltage profile.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No generic stimulus command. Use only the approved fixture SOP and vendor blackbox extraction interface after all electrical and record semantics are supplied.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 5 and Machine Time 5 are retained as source data but not treated as a safe or sufficient dwell profile.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define one rail-specific waveform and abort envelope, synchronize calibrated measurement, perform a single operator-controlled injection, then export and correlate the immutable blackbox record.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the named PSU, load/isolation topology and calibrated fixture approved by the owner.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU/BMC firmware, fixture/calibration and blackbox tool/schema versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project/vendor OVP and blackbox documentation must be supplied; no voltage value or injection method is invented.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the over-voltage event measurable and bounded while preserving the blackbox-record objective.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One approved rail/profile proves only that fault record path, not all rails or all OVP behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Rail, waveform, limits, fixture, measurement/cutoff, expected record and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect topology can expose the PSU, load and platform to damaging voltage before protection operates.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a lower-risk vendor injection mechanism or one rail/profile; completion must report actual voltage/time and exact coverage. Software reboot, AC removal or another fault is not an equivalent substitute.
expected_evidence: Approved OVP profile, rail, topology, fixture calibration and safety checklist
Operator record plus calibrated actual voltage/current/time waveform and protection/cutoff response
Raw blackbox export with schema/tool version and expected over-voltage field comparison
Preserved platform logs and verified post-event recovery/inspection

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title identifies the status whose blackbox persistence is checked; procedure and criterion are compatible but omit the electrical and record details.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A safe over-voltage operation cannot be inferred without a rail, waveform, limits, fixture and expected record. These missing semantics are safety-critical, so BLOCKED is justified rather than ordinary readiness.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree the agent cannot perform the event, but reject the speculative fault mechanisms and unsupported blackbox-access claim.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with BLOCKED and the required independent measurement, fixture, protection and record/recovery contract.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates operator stimulus from potentially automated evidence extraction and names the exact coverage boundary.

review_improvement: This review converts the vague blackbox check into a traceable rail/waveform/record contract, explains the true blocker and forbids non-equivalent AC or software substitutes.
independent_technical_reasoning: Over-voltage is a specific but inherently hazardous stimulus. Human operation alone is insufficient when voltage/time limits and protection expectations are absent. Because inventing those values could damage hardware, the case remains BLOCKED until the complete vendor plan exists.

no_automatic_retry: The approved profile may be applied once. Any limit exceedance, protection anomaly or recovery failure requires immediate cutoff, evidence preservation and stop; no reinjection/reset/power cycle is automatic.
